item.title: Kabza De Small Set to Drop KOA 3
item.description: Kabza De Small has confirmed that his upcoming album, KOA 3, is nearing release after responding to a fan on social media who asked whether the project would drop this year. The producer indicated that the album is complete and currently awaiting final artwork, suggesting that recording and production have already been finalized. item.title: De Rose Signals Possible Shift With Hip-Hop Tease
item.description: De Rose has given fans a glimpse into a possible new chapter. A short TikTok teaser sees the amapiano vocalist testing her voice over a hip-hop beat, produced by Frank Mabeat and Lokzin Keys, while directly asking supporters if this sound should turn into an EP. The moment has sparked curiosity around her next move and hints at a shift that could broaden her musical reach. item.title: “We go Harder as Individuals,”LaCabra on How Qwellers’ Members’Solo Releases Keep the Collective Active
item.description: LaCabra recently explained how The Qwellers continue to stay active through the solo work of their members during an appearance on the L-Tido Podcast New Gen. He noted that while the collective does not release music as frequently as a group, individual members consistently drop solo projects that sustain the collective’s momentum.
